positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developer on the Hitachi Content Platform.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Member of the Advanced Communication Networks Laboratory run by Dr. Vinod Vokkarane.

Responsibilities and Achievements:

- Research and develop mathematical models and software simulators for network routing, with a focus on survivability for multicast and many-to-many communications.

- Author conference and journal publications on research topics ranging from multicast node-failure protection, green manycast overlays, electricity-cost-aware routing, and survivable network resource schedulers. 

- Design and implement the "What-if" suggestion engine for dynamically generating network resource reservation options as a key deliverable for the Department of Energy PROPER grant. Oversee undergraduate student participation in the development process.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
Research Intern
positions.description:
Undergraduate member of the Netlab research group run by Dr. Vinod Vokkarane.

Responsibilities and Achievements:

- Programmed simulators and developed algorithms for network routing, with a focus on provisioning greenhouse gas emissions-aware dynamic manycast traffic.

- Co-authored a publication for Globecom 2013 on Energy Source-Aware Manycast Overlays in WDM Networks.

projects.title: Survivability Simulator
projects.description: Simulator used to test and evaluate the performance of a number of survivable routing algorithms. Built on Spring Framework to support interactions with external SDN applications. Uses the AMPL API to generate optimal linear programming solutions. Integration with AWS (DynamoDB and S3) for remote storage of simulation results.

projects.title: On-Demand Secure Circuit Advance Reservation System (OSCARS)
projects.description: Developed the prototype Path Computation Engine for OSCARS, which supports disjoint path provisioning, VLAN tag translation, and bundling of discrete bandwidth reservations. Created initial framework for the Web UI using HTML5 and React.js.
